Brand introduction:
   Welcome to FunkyDecors.com, the premier destination for home decor enthusiasts in India and abroad. We are renowned for our exquisite collection of wall clocks, table lamps, paintings, and showpieces. At FunkyDecors, we blend creativity with functionality to transform living spaces into vibrant reflections of personal style.

Product description: 
   Our curated selection includes an array of wall clocks that range from minimalist designs to statement pieces that redefine timekeeping. Our table lamps combine artistic flair with practical lighting solutions, catering to diverse tastes and interiors. Our paintings showcase artistic mastery across various genres, while our showpieces add charm and character to any room.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
   At FunkyDecors, our USP lies in our ability to offer not just products, but unique expressions of individuality for every home. Each item in our collection is carefully curated to bring style, sophistication, and a touch of whimsy to your living space. Our commitment to quality craftsmanship and innovative design ensures that every piece from FunkyDecors becomes a conversation starter and a cherished addition to your decor.

Payment terms:
   We offer hassle-free payment options including credit/debit card payments, net banking, and cash on delivery (COD) for domestic orders. For international orders, we accept payments through secure online transactions. Detailed payment information is available during checkout on our website.

Other information:


   - Shipping: We provide fast and reliable shipping options both within India and internationally. Shipping costs and delivery times may vary based on location and order size.
   - Customer Support: Our dedicated customer support team is available to assist you with any queries regarding products, orders, or after-sales service. Contact us via email at info@funkydecors.com or call our customer care hotline at +91 8879653657 (India) or international contact number for overseas customers.
   - Returns and Refunds: We have a straightforward return and refund policy. Please refer to our website or contact customer support for detailed information on our return process and eligibility criteria.
